summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Capture, Collection, and Analysis Training Course. Learn effective techniques to gather and analyze data efficiently.
lede: Data collection and analysis training covers how professionals who gather, validate, or report records can turn them into traceable evidence. Participants practice defining decision-focused requirements, designing validated forms, assessing data quality, and preparing reproducible datasets with Excel and Power Query. They also use descriptive statistics and Power BI dashboards to explain findings and communicate limitations to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This data collection and analysis course is designed for professionals who create collection instruments, manage incoming records, assess quality, analyze findings, or report evidence to operational and executive stakeholders.
modules: CRISP-DM Data Collection and Analysis Foundations
ISO/IEC 25012 Data Collection and Analysis Quality
Power BI Data Visualization and Reporting
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course requires basic familiarity with spreadsheets, operational records, surveys, monitoring data, or recurring reports. You should be comfortable entering data and using simple spreadsheet formulas, but you do not need prior statistical training, database expertise, or programming experience. No coding is required for completion. Bring a laptop capable of running a current desktop spreadsheet application and Power BI Desktop where installation policies allow it. Advanced analytics, SQL, and AI-assisted review receive conceptual or operational coverage; the course does not require technical engineering or production deployment.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
